raw_segments.text: The famous French writer Piron, we were all drinking then, a big party of us in a tavern at that very fair.
They'd invited me, and first of all I began quoting epigrams.
Is that you, Boilo? What a funny getup.
And Boilo answers that he's going to a masquerade, that is to the baths, hee hee.
And they took it to themselves, so I made haste to repeat another, very sarcastic, well-known to all educated people.
